description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing interest pause periods associated with loans in the Fineract project. It provides create, retrieve, update, and delete operations for interest pauses, accessible via HTTP endpoints. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for routing, Swagger annotations for API documentation, Lombok for boilerplate reduction, and interacts with core services for security and command processing.

classes.name: LoanInterestPauseApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource for managing interest pauses on loans, with endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting interest pause periods, identified by loan ID or external loan ID.

methods.name: createInterestPause
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new interest pause period for a specific loan by ID.

methods.name: createInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new interest pause period for a loan identified by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPauses
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all interest pause periods for a specific loan by ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPausesByExternalId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all interest pause periods for a loan by external ID.

methods.name: deleteInterestPause
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a specific interest pause period by variation ID for a loan identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a specific interest pause period by variation ID for a loan identified by external ID.

methods.name: updateInterestPause
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an interest pause period for a loan by ID.

methods.name: updateInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an interest pause period by external ID.
